description:
We are a team building an interactive Python app (using Streamlit & spatial libraries) that maps and tells the history of space hardware left behind on celestial bodies.

Skills : Python, basic data science, visual structuring.

Looking for: Teammates interested in data compilation, UI layout, or mapping libraries.
summary: "The Quiet Ones" is a Python-only Streamlit web app that tells the emotional stories of 23 NASA spacecraft left behind across the solar system — Moon, Mars, and deep space.
details:
"The Quiet Ones" is a Python-only Streamlit web app that tells the emotional stories of 23 NASA spacecraft left behind across the solar system — Moon, Mars, and deep space.

8 Pages Built:

  1. 🏠 Hero Home with live counters
  2. 🗺️ Interactive Atlas maps (Moon, Mars, Deep Space)
  3. 📡 First-person machine stories
  4. ⌛ Timeline of Silence (Gantt chart)
  5. ⚖️ Then vs. Now comparison cards
  6. 🌿 Memorial Wall with live notes
  7. 🎯 Cosmic Quiz (8 questions)
  8. 🏛️ Heritage & Sources
